dogecoin.text: @elonmusk @dogecoin_devs I'll definitely do both, but also want to know when might I be able to pay for my Starlink service using Dogecoin? I may not be able to send Doge to the moon, but I can use my Doge to send my data in the general direction 😁

@ckmarley19 @dogecoin_devs I am confused, why do we need a company to charge fees to use their cards when we can just as easily scan a barcode/QR code and complete our desired transaction? I like my Doge and want to keep as much of it as possible. I can already see the credit card companies salivating.

@elonmusk @itsALLrisky I am so happy he said this.
